name: Connor Thomas
bio:
Conz Thomas is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in minimalist, fineline, and dotwork styles based out of London, United Kingdom. They have amassed roughly 68,000 followers on Instagram, an indication of their widespread recognition and popularity. Despite the incoming flow of clientele, their professional ethos is underscored by maintaining a clean and orderly workspace at Project London Studio. Most notably, Thomas excels by keeping communication lines open, avoiding DMs, and opening books for advanced appointments - a testament to their high demand and professionalism.
